findings.evidence: specs/platform-rollout/spec.md:964-972 (ADDED "The Copier upgrade test falls back to a bootstrap baseline without a stable tag") and :974-982 (smoke test skips when there is no baseline). specs/publication-recovery/spec.md:1314-1320 ("retains the existing bounded foreground check/merge fallback"). specs/platform-delegation/spec.md:548-555 (detection-only "bounded compatibility fallback"). Also :520-527 (guarded fallback for unproven native containment).
findings.summary: The split carries over several fallback behaviors that already existed in the specs. The user's no-fallbacks rule asks for these to be reported, not extended. The split does not add or widen any of them.

findings.evidence: specs/platform-rollout/spec.md:636-649 (MODIFIED scenarios on a root commit and an unchanged VERSION) against :994-1016 (ADDED root-commit and non-root release-intent requirements). :675-679 (bootstrap run does not dispatch rollout) against :1054-1068. specs/gate-fail-explicit/spec.md:184-200 (MODIFIED scenarios for main without --base and for git diff failing) against :305-321 (ADDED requirements for the same behaviors). specs/worktree-coordination/spec.md:1597-1602 and 1630-1650 against :1862-1902.
findings.summary: Several ADDED requirements restate behavior that the kept MODIFIED scenarios already assert, so one behavior is now specified in two places. A later edit to one copy can leave the other stale. The design's own mechanical guard (word coverage) does not detect such drift.
